== Course of events ==

Dorothy and her companions reached the Castle of Glinda after crossing a boggy, marshy region and a large, ancient forest, having earlier been fed a large meal by a farmer's wife who directed them south toward the castle. At the castle gates, girl soldiers in red-and-gold uniforms questioned Dorothy before agreeing to announce her to Glinda. Glinda agreed to receive Dorothy and her companions at once, granting them the audience they had traveled south to seek.

This meeting followed the travelers' passage through the ancient forest and preceded their onward journey, during which they would face the armless Hammer-Heads guarding a rocky hill and pass through the rich, prosperous Quadling Country.
